key.name: shortcut-enabled
key.description: When enabled, the extension registers a keyboard shortcut that toggles Always on Top on the focused window, like the top bar button.

key.name: aot-toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut used when the shortcut is enabled. Not shown in the preferences window; it can be changed with gsettings or dconf. The key name is deliberately specific: keybinding names share one global namespace in GNOME Shell, and a generic name can clash with another extension.
